none: PAS FindID 965986: Roman Coin: Plated Severan Denarius of an indeterminate ruler
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Silver washed denarius of an indeterminate female Severan issuer, probably an indeterminate Julia (all 193 or 218-219 to 222), Reece period 10. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right, prominent eye and lips. Obverse inscription: [--]IVL[--]AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Draped figure standing facing, vertical sceptre in left hand, right arm extended and crooked. Reverse inscription: [---]TIS. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 1.89gms, die axis: 6
